task.title: Export shared schemas and DTOs for the new domains
task.input: Field contracts in sections 06/09/10, the existing Auth.js error protocol and the visual-base baseline
task.output: contract-types; account/recovery/chat/analytics/ops/errors schemas and public index exports
task.accept: 1) Establish strict Zod request/response schemas by checking every field against section 10; derive types only from schemas, make the public index consumable by independent TypeScript code, and reject unknown or out-of-bound fields. 2) LoginMode accepts only password/totp; missing rememberDevice, boolean false and literal false parse as false, while other invalid values are rejected. (E-95).
